title: Connected workspace implementation backlog
baseline: ACCEPTANCE.md records the prior local v0; these packages are unimplemented planned work.

external_requirements.reachable_gateway: Authorized activation of a reachable authenticated endpoint for cloud clients.
external_requirements.muse_connection: Actual Muse account connects through MCP and executes its configured heartbeat.
external_requirements.chatgpt_work_connection: Actual ChatGPT Work connection and scheduled tool access.
external_requirements.agentos_disposable_context: Authorized disposable AgentOS host/context with qualified provider and collaboration-tool access.
external_requirements.agentos_required_support: Any missing controller/runtime capabilities identified in W11 are implemented and qualified separately, under appropriate authorization.
external_requirements.github_test_remote: Exact selected test repository and authorized publication connection/scopes.

implementation_policy.core_rule: Configuration for existing protocols; new protocol adapters cannot change domain semantics.
implementation_policy.external_gate_rule: Continue independent local work; leave the affected live qualification pending.
implementation_policy.authority: Deferred full roadmap. Not the active launch queue. NEXT_BACKLOG.json governs the initial deployed release.
implementation_policy.parallelism_policy: Dependency readiness does not authorize concurrent edits to shared files. Serialize schema/migrations, command dispatch, and shared frontend edits unless ownership has been explicitly split.

tasks.title: Freeze shared contracts and editable defaults
tasks.scope: Define principals, grants, connection bindings, subscriptions, pickup policies, connector capabilities, task execution policies, and migration invariants. Keep brands in templates/adapters only.
acceptance: Versioned schema distinguishes visibility, response requests, claims, and execution approval.
Define actor-scoped idempotency and exact request/attempt generations across every transport.
Existing identity and Resource revision semantics survive; substantive owner input can renew a bounded discussion burst without handoff renewal.

tasks.title: Implement participant identity and scoped authorization
tasks.scope: Add independent connection grants, explicit internal-service authority, rotation/revocation, and account plus request scope. Preserve owner login while separating participant access.
acceptance: An authenticated participant cannot impersonate the owner, another agent, or a different attempt.
Private DM, staged-answer, and memory boundaries apply to reads, previews, events, uploads/downloads, and mutations.
External results use explicit checked transitions rather than generic owner privilege; revoked grants fail immediately on new operations.

tasks.title: Migrate records and add bounded transactional queries
tasks.scope: Add indexed grants/connections/relationships/claim storage. Replace whole-workspace reads and global locking incrementally on active query and mutation paths.
acceptance: Migration preserves existing IDs, revisions, attachments, history, and unresolved work without dispatch.
Paged inbox/task/message queries return bounded authorized rows without loading every record.
Concurrent commands retain stale-write detection, transactional reservations, and deterministic lock ordering.

tasks.title: Unify inbox claims, handoffs, and delivery intents
tasks.scope: Implement durable participant inboxes and transactional wakeup intents over canonical requests/tasks, with shared admission for managed execution and external clients.
acceptance: Reading does not claim; overlapping polling and push admit one current attempt.
Cancellation, resolution, correction, or revoked authority before pickup prevents stale execution.
Duplicate replies/results return stable receipts; expired started attempts require reconciliation.
Handoffs retain origin, return destination, authority, and discussion allowance; cycles cannot renew work indefinitely.

tasks.title: Expose the checked participant API and MCP server
tasks.scope: Provide versioned MCP and HTTP entry points for account discovery, inbox/claims/context, replies/handoffs, Resources/files, task capture/proposals, checkpoints, and results.
acceptance: A generic client can discover its own identity, claim a request, create a real Resource, and reply with stable IDs.
Equivalent MCP and HTTP operations enforce the same authorization, revision, idempotency, and pagination rules.
Agent tools cannot approve work scopes, accept results, administer connections, or gain repository access through ordinary chat.
Malformed input and unsupported operations return bounded actionable errors without leaking private objects.

tasks.title: Build connection registry, presets, and Add agent flow
tasks.scope: Create reusable editable connection presets and an agent setup UI with purpose, scope, method, generated instructions, observed capabilities, and grant management.
acceptance: An unfamiliar agent can connect on a supported protocol with no product-specific domain code.
Two copies of one template have distinct grants and inboxes; template edits do not silently mutate existing agents.
Generated heartbeat instructions contain no credentials; connection tests distinguish authentication, tool success, and observed scheduled pickup.
Renaming an agent or changing its connection preserves history and pending request IDs.

tasks.title: Route managed Codex and immediate wakeups through connections
tasks.scope: Replace the single runtime instance with a capability-based registry, preserve Codex qualification, and add bounded configurable webhook wakeups to trusted destinations.
acceptance: Both managed Codex and external participants use common claim/cancel/result semantics.
Webhook retries and polling fallback cannot create duplicate admitted attempts; delivery acknowledgment is separate from completion.
Private/runtime session limits remain enforced; unsupported isolation, steering, or cancellation is visible.
Only configured trusted destinations receive signed wakeups; redirects or supplied URLs cannot leak credentials.

tasks.title: Prepare authenticated remote access for cloud clients
tasks.scope: Package the remote MCP/HTTP gateway, client-compatible OAuth or supported scoped-token setup, TLS/proxy configuration, and connectivity diagnostics. Keep local operation.
acceptance: Participant access never requires an owner cookie or an exposed owner-command endpoint.
Local protocol tests exercise auth expiry, audience/scope validation, reconnect, and revocation.
Document and test supported client authentication; cloud reachability is explicitly pending until actual activation.
Deployment configuration and rollback are reviewable without provisioning or publishing during implementation.

tasks.title: Qualify Muse using the generic heartbeat preset
tasks.scope: Connect Muse through the owner-confirmed custom MCP and editable heartbeat support; use the generic external participant mechanism with no incoming webhook.
acceptance: An actual heartbeat retrieves only its own inbox, claims a current request, writes a Resource, and replies to the original thread.
A cancelled or corrected request before pickup is handled without stale execution.
Record schedule owner, observed check-in, grant scope, tool/result evidence, and connection limitations without secrets.

tasks.title: Qualify ChatGPT Work scheduled participation
tasks.scope: Connect a separately authenticated ChatGPT Work participant using the same generic API and confirm tool access in its actual scheduled environment.
acceptance: A real scheduled run reads, claims, returns a Resource/reply, and preserves request identity.
Unavailable tools, reconnect requirements, or approvals are visible failures, not a claimed integration.
Qualification records supported tool actions and scope independently of Muse's result.

tasks.title: Map the actual AgentOS controller contract and gaps
tasks.scope: Inspect current AgentOS capabilities and map identity/configuration/task/receipt operations. Document exact unsupported requirements as upstream work without changing AgentOS.
acceptance: Map Unix/SSH transport, source revisions, durable idempotency, read/chat/edit/deploy grants, input limits, and bounded output.
Document session isolation, steering, MCP/tool delivery, provider qualification, and unknown-run reconciliation support accurately.
Every upstream gap has an operation, affected journey, acceptance criterion, and an independent-work path.

tasks.title: Implement the workspace-side AgentOS runtime adapter
tasks.scope: Translate workspace attempts to AgentOS submissions and receipts using supported controller operations, without duplicating task authority or bypassing AgentOS.
acceptance: Workspace task/attempt, AgentOS receipt, and provider run IDs remain distinct and linked.
Lost responses reconcile the original receipt/key; unknown acceptance never triggers blind resubmission.
Observed cancellation, transport acknowledgment, output retention/gaps, and unsupported operations remain distinct.
Protocol fixture tests preserve current context and host enforcement; payloads respect inspected limits.

tasks.title: Add AgentOS agent discovery and configuration controls
tasks.scope: Map managed identities and expose supported declaration/assignment/status operations through AgentOS authority with previews, expected revisions, and explicit grants.
acceptance: Stable AgentOS identities map to existing participants across renames and runtime changes.
Cached desired/effective/observed state includes source revision and observation time; drift is visible.
Supported configuration changes preview their effects and reject stale revisions; unsupported edits are explained.
Membership remains workspace-owned; secrets and host lifecycle are not copied into a competing configuration authority.

tasks.title: Qualify a real disposable AgentOS-managed agent
tasks.scope: Run a bounded real task and collaboration return path through the selected AgentOS connection on an authorized disposable context.
acceptance: Submission survives client disconnection and reconnects to the same durable receipt.
Verify actual tool/file evidence and an authenticated Resource/reply, not only a runtime success string.
Cancellation and uncertain dispatch are tested or explicitly left unqualified without replay.
A direct Hermes run cannot satisfy this AgentOS gate.

tasks.title: Complete messaging, threads, Auto routing, and the human Inbox
tasks.scope: Finish channels/threads, agent discovery, replies/forwards, unread state, drafts/scroll, deep links, meaningful notifications, and bounded model-assisted routing/invitations.
acceptance: Natural follow-ups preserve focus after unrelated progress; forwarded mentions and acknowledgments do not wake everyone.
Explicit recipients override Auto; selector failure does not broadcast or expand permission.
Independent replies remain staged; missing/late respondents and Stop/correction behavior are clear.
Actual browser checks cover draft/scroll recovery, queued agents, recipient override, and return to the source thread.

tasks.title: Add decisions, conversation briefs, and inspectable context
tasks.scope: Represent decisions, unresolved questions, alternatives, and source-linked brief coverage explicitly. Preserve original records and permission-checked retrieval.
acceptance: Briefs expose source coverage and omissions; proposed decisions cannot silently become accepted requirements.
Context manifests distinguish initial input, later retrieval, and corrections.
Private DM and independent-round data stay inaccessible through summaries or shared memory.
Updates invalidate stale derived context while preserving original revisions and evidence.

tasks.title: Finish shared Resource and file workflows
tasks.scope: Add bounded search, backlinks, syntax-highlighted pastes, section reads, agent file transfer, and clear pinned/latest navigation.
acceptance: The same Resource appears in multiple permitted locations without copies or implicit grants.
Concurrent revisions conflict without losing drafts; pinned attachments retain exact bytes/text.
Agents upload and retrieve actual files through checked paths; unsupported extraction is labeled.
Search, snippets, previews, sections, and downloads all enforce current access.

tasks.title: Complete progressive planning and execution constraints
tasks.scope: Expand milestones, alternatives, explicit blockers/questions, reviewable plan diffs, task references, execution policies, write areas, locks, and prerequisite code. Preserve title-only capture.
acceptance: A substantial roadmap can be built incrementally in the outline, with compact board/dependency views over the same records.
Cycle/alternative/blocker handling produces actionable explanations.
Plan changes preview affected requirements/dependencies and invalidate stale approvals appropriately.
Replace the simplified parallel flag with Automatic/Isolated/Exclusive/Manual behavior and conservative treatment of unknown scope.

tasks.title: Qualify general project execution and bounded work sessions
tasks.scope: Add reviewed isolated build/test execution profiles, qualified worker selection, shared locks, checkpoint recovery, provider capacity pools, and review reserves.
acceptance: Real agents run meaningful project checks with recorded commands, exit status, and commit-bound evidence.
Two compatible tasks overlap; conflicting write/host/service resources wait; target checkout and credentials remain protected.
Manual/webhook starts share approval and idempotency; reset hints do not manufacture quota or new work.
Interrupted work preserves changes; unknown provider execution holds its reservations until safe reconciliation.

tasks.title: Implement scoped GitHub connections and draft PR publication
tasks.scope: Add selected-repository connection setup and a publisher outside worker environments. Preserve existing read integration and prepare branch/draft-PR writes for explicitly authorized remotes.
acceptance: Publication is limited to the approved repository/attempt branch and draft PR actions.
Workers cannot read publication credentials or write target branches through another path.
Duplicate or uncertain publication reconciles the same branch/PR identity before retry.
Required scopes and connection setup are documented; fixture tests are labeled and live writes remain a separate gate.

tasks.title: Synchronize GitHub checks, reviews, and task links
tasks.scope: Implement authenticated events, deduplication, reconciliation, and exact-head PR/check/review records with related-versus-fulfilling task links.
acceptance: Duplicate/out-of-order events converge; a missed event is repaired through reconciliation.
New head commits invalidate stale evidence; closed-unmerged PRs do not complete tasks.
Support multiple PRs per task and multiple task links per PR without duplicated execution state.
Relevant updates appear in task/project/conversation views without waking every group member.

tasks.title: Verify branch combinations and prerequisite integration
tasks.scope: Add a serial integration-verification queue using disposable checkouts and exact candidate/target commits. Preserve human acceptance and manual merge.
acceptance: Individually passing branches that fail together are reported as an integration failure.
Dependent code work waits for the required accepted/integrated prerequisite and verified ancestry.
Changed baseline/requirements invalidate stale verification; interrupted integration preserves evidence.
No automatic target-branch write, merge, or deployment is introduced.

tasks.title: Add scoped shared memory with provenance
tasks.scope: Implement typed facts/preferences/decisions/lessons with source links, scopes, proposed/accepted state, retrieval, and correction/retraction history.
acceptance: Agents can propose, search, and reuse permitted durable knowledge across sessions.
Private/group/project/workspace boundaries hold during search and context assembly.
Retraction/revocation removes stale derived retrieval access without claiming external provider erasure.
Memory cannot approve tasks, alter permissions, or override pinned requirements.

tasks.title: Qualify large-roadmap queries and interface performance
tasks.scope: Finish indexed PostgreSQL text search, bounded event replay, pagination, virtualization, and a reproducible workload benchmark.
acceptance: Exercise 50 agents, 10000 tasks, 100000 messages, and 10000 Resource revisions without full-workspace fetches.
Record hardware and p95 warm-read/write/claim latency under ten clients against the plan's explicit targets.
Permission filters survive pagination/search and concurrent updates.
Large outline navigation, inbox use, and search remain responsive in actual browser checks.

tasks.title: Upgrade backup, restore, deployment packaging, and diagnostics
tasks.scope: Package local/private-host operation, migrations, health diagnostics, redacted bounded logs, and backup/restore for the expanded records and connection metadata.
acceptance: Upgrade and restore preserve record identity, Resource checksums, links, and attempt receipts.
Restored dispatch is paused; uncertain work and external connections require deliberate reconciliation/reactivation.
Document external secret custody and reconnect steps rather than promising a database dump restores provider access.
Startup/shutdown and local operation work without requiring public hosting or recurring paid services.

tasks.title: Run connected-release acceptance and write the handoff
tasks.scope: Execute the original A/B/C cases plus new participant/memory/scale journeys, record real versus fixture evidence, and leave an idle runnable release.
acceptance: Real polling and immediate agents exchange work, Resources, and results without manual context transfer.
Approved coding produces a verified draft PR and correct review/integration state.
Interruption/restart/restore and permission revocation retain truthful state with no duplicate execution.
All required integration gates are separately reported; unqualified clients do not become complete through substitutes.
Release handoff states commands, operating limits, live/fixture proof, and remaining external setup; no test agents remain running.

tasks.title: Qualify live GitHub delivery on an authorized test remote
tasks.scope: Run a bounded approved coding task through project tests, branch publication, draft PR, review/check updates, and dependency/integration observations.
acceptance: Verify actual remote commit and draft PR IDs match the recorded task attempt.
Observe exact-head checks and reconcile a simulated missed event against real remote state.
Exercise replay without duplicate PR creation and preserve the no-auto-merge/no-deploy policy.

tasks.title: Complete the unified desktop and phone experience
tasks.scope: Unify cards/deep links/detail panels, meaningful Inbox actions, absence digest, keyboard/screen-reader behavior, phone flows, and installable web-app metadata.
acceptance: A user can message, save material, plan, inspect a PR/result, and return without losing their draft or place.
Agent setup defaults work without opening advanced controls; waiting/blocked/unknown states provide a next action.
Source-linked return-after-absence digest distinguishes proposals, completed outputs, accepted work, and outstanding decisions.
Actual desktop/phone browser interactions cover keyboard, scrolling, errors, reconnect, and no private API caching or automatic execution replay.
